classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_fingers.d: Picking a pocket or a lock takes a tenth less time, each rank: a shorter reach in a pocket, and in a lock the strain eases and a stiff pin lifts that much quicker.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_case.desc: Sneak and watch someone for three seconds and you read them: two pips under the crosshair. The left is red if they are wary of you, green if at ease; the right is gold if their pockets are worth it, grey if not.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_fence.des: What you lift from a pocket is stolen goods. Sneak and use them on a speakeasy's fence and he buys the lot: half their worth from anyone else, full price from you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_storey.de: Landings and climbing are heard by anything with ears. Yours aren't: a landing from under six blocks, and your climbing, make no sound.
A pocket fumbled only makes the mark wary: no cry, no crime, no grudge. They keep a hand on their purse for a day.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_shadow_bl: A light blade in the back of a foe that never knew you were there, and is no hardier than you, always puts it down. Never a boss.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.thief_ghost.des: Out of Vanish, and for six seconds after its cover is gone, your first blow counts as a sneak attack on a foe that never knew, and you leave no blood trail.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_eye.desc: Your arrows and bolts leave the string nearer the line of your eye and a little faster, so truer and further, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_dress.de: Butchering your own kill on the meat hook gives one more round of cuts.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_fletch.d: You craft six arrows a set instead of four, and an arrow of yours that kills isn't broken: it drops where the kill fell.
Crouched and still in grass, ferns, a bush or against leaves, nothing sees you from more than six blocks away. Bosses still may.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_warden.d: You feel a favoured foe within 24 blocks as a heartbeat only you hear, quicker and louder the more squarely you face it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.ranger_heart.de: A full-drawn shot at a favoured foe that never knew you were there can't miss or glance off the head you called it on.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_hide.desc: You take 15% less harm from your own element, each rank: its natural harm (fire for fire, drowning for water, cold for ice, and so on) and spells of it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_quick.desc: Your sigil's wait is a third shorter.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_chain.desc: A sigil that bursts on a foe jumps to one more foe within four blocks, at half strength.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_memory.desc: An imbued blade you put away stops burning down until you draw it again.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.sor_well.desc: Standing in your element (fire, water or rain, storm, snow and ice, bare ground, open wind, flowers, soul ground) your mana comes back twice as fast.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mage_scholar.de: Learning a spell from a scroll takes study: three seconds of reading. You need half of it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mage_battle.des: A staff in your hand strikes like a mace, and casting doesn't lower your guard: a shield on your other arm still turns blows from the front for a moment after each cast.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_sight.desc: You see in the dark while you owe your patron a debt.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_time.desc: Once a rest, a blow that would put you down is put on your account instead: you are left on two hearts, and an open debt falls due a day sooner (with none open, one is opened).
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_tithe.desc: Each foe you kill while owing pays off part of the debt: five settle it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_usury.desc: Your casts hit a fifth harder while you owe, and the next debt comes a fifth sooner.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wlk_hand.desc: Settle a debt before it falls overdue, and your next rest gives you one cast that costs nothing: no slot, and nothing on the account.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_tongue.desc: Beasts of a kind you have studied don't flee you, and those of them that hunt don't hunt you unless you strike first.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_thumb.desc: Crops and saplings within six blocks of where you sleep the night grow one stage by morning.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_hide.desc: In a shape, blows under three damage are shrugged off.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_paws.desc: In a shape, you run a fifth faster and leap further.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.dru_heart.desc: Once a rest, a blow that would bring you down in a shape throws you back into your own body instead, at the health you had when you took it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_steady.desc: A hit taken while you hold a prayer doesn't break it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_candle.desc: Your raised symbol gives light, and the undead within six blocks of it are slowed.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_shepherd.de: Your blessing reaches every friend within 12 blocks, not only your band: villagers and townsfolk, anyone's pets, golems, those who follow you.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_exorcist.de: Turn the Undead also drives out possession and the living nightmare (your own too), and tears a shapeshifter's stolen face off.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.cle_inter.desc: Once a rest, a friend going down within eight blocks of you stands back up on two hearts.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_step.desc: You take no harm from falls under eight blocks, and never trample crops.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_palm.desc: Your bare hands break wood as an iron tool would, a little slower, and it drops as if cut. At the second rank, stone too.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.monk_fast.desc: You grow hungry half as fast.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_stead.desc: You can't be knocked back while you block.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_avenger.des: When a friend within 12 blocks goes down, your next smite in the ten seconds after costs nothing, even with none left.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_redeemer.de: A foe you bring down and leave alive never raises a hand to you again.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.pal_beacon.desc: Friends inside your aura can't be frightened or Overcome, and a fright or a faint they came in with is lifted.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wl_drilled.desc: Your followers form up twice as fast, and a soldier in formation hit from afar holds his place.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.wl_wall.desc: Blocking beside another raised shield, both of you stop arrows, bolts and shot from the front outright.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.br_skull.desc: Blows to the head knock you out cold half as often.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.br_scar.desc: Your wounds stop bleeding a third sooner.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_powder.desc: Your powder takes when you are wet: rain, standing water or a soaking no longer stop the shot. Under water, still nothing burns.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_sharp.desc: Kneel or crouch still for two seconds, gun in hand, and your next shot flies dead along your eye and a quarter further.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_slinger.desc: For a second after a gun comes to your hand you aim twice as fast: the match comes down, your aim steadies and finds its mark in half the time, with half the stray.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_farrier.des: Feeding your own horse also mends it by two hearts, and its hooves never wear down to lameness on hard ground.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.rid_seat.desc: You aren't thrown by a lance hit, a rearing horse or a bucking one.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_clock.desc: Your gadgets' waits are a quarter shorter.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_scrap.desc: A gadget of yours that wears out and breaks gives back half the parts it was built from.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.wary: %s felt your hand, and keeps a hand on their purse.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.fence_noth: That's not worth a coin. Keep it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.fence_plai: Hot goods. Half, take it or leave it: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.wild_heart: Your wild heart throws you back into your own body.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.avenge: %s has fallen. Your next smite costs nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.intercessi: Your prayer lifts %s back to their feet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.tithe: The patron takes its tithe: %s of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.hand_open: The patron's hand is open: your next cast costs nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.borrowed: Borrowed time. The patron asks %s within %s days.
message.jaymoskingdoms.extras.borrowed_m: Borrowed time. The patron wants %s sooner.
